items.author: Garrett Ball
items.desc: The New York Giants D/ST racked up three sacks and two interceptions in the team's 23-18 win over the Jaguars on Sunday.
items.impact: Abdul Carter and the Giants were pressuring Lawrence all afternoon, giving the powerful Jags offense little space to work. They will get a great matchup against the Colts next week.
items.title: New York Giants D/ST rattle Jags in win

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.desc: Dominic Zvada hit both of his PATs and three of four field goal attempts in the Giants' 23-18 win over the Jaguars on Sunday.
items.impact: Zvada had a miss in this game, but thankfully for him it was not a deciding factor for this game, though it could have been had things fallen differently. He's now missed four field goal attempts in his last four games, so the Giants could start entertaining new names for the job.
items.title: Dominic Zvada goes for 11 kicking points in win over Jags

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.desc: Devin Singletary ran once for five yards and caught his only target for five yards in the Giants' 23-18 win over the Jags on Sunday.
items.impact: Singletary was a distant second to Cam Skattebo in running back attempts and targets in this game, and irrelevant for fantasy. It will likely stay that way unless Skattebo is punished for his fumbling issues.
items.title: Devin Singletary quiet in win over Jags

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.desc: Malachi Fields caught two of five targets for 25 yards in the Giants' 23-18 win over the Jaguars on Sunday.
items.impact: Fields had a couple of nice grabs in this contest, but didn't do much for fantasy purposes. He's not worth rostering for fantasy right now, with Malik Nabers and Isaiah Likely taking so much of the work.
items.title: Malachi Fields snags two passes in win

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.desc: Isaiah Likely caught one of three targets for 35 yards in the Giants' 23-18 win over the Jaguars on Sunday.
items.impact: If nothing else, at least Likely's one catch was a big gain. However, he dropped a sure-fire touchdown from Jameis Winston, which would have greatly helped his fantasy day. He will look to bounce back against Indianapolis next week.
items.title: Isaiah Likely drops touchdown in win over Jags

items.author: Joshua Kellem
items.desc: The Raiders' defense surrendered 351 total yards, while recording one sack and one interception in Las Vegas' 38-24 loss to Denver in Week 11.
items.impact: The Broncos scored 38 points, seven of which came via a Ja'Quan McMillian pick-six and the ensuing extra point. Las Vegas intercepted Bo Nix but allowed Jonah Coleman to rush for 111 yards and three touchdowns. One sack and one takeaway weren't enough to offset the points allowed. The Raiders D/ST remains difficult to trust in fantasy heading into Week 12 against Cleveland.
items.title: Raiders D/ST allows 31 offensive points in Week 11

items.author: Joshua Kellem
items.desc: Matt Gay converted his lone field-goal attempt and all three extra-point attempts in the Raiders' 38-24 loss to the Broncos in Week 11.
items.impact: Gay connected from 28 yards out in the second quarter after a would-be touchdown to Jalen Nailor was negated by a penalty. The veteran kicker was listed as questionable entering Sunday with a right hip injury but converted all four of his kicks. He'll get the Browns on the road in Week 12.
items.title: Matt Gay makes all four kicks in Week 11

items.author: Joshua Kellem
items.desc: Ian Thomas caught his only target for a 19-yard touchdown in the Raiders' 38-24 loss to the Broncos in Week 11.
items.impact: Thomas caught Fernando Mendoza's second career touchdown pass, tying the game at 17 in the third quarter. Brock Bowers was inactive, while Michael Mayer exited Sunday's game with an injury. Thomas could see additional opportunities if both tight ends miss Week 12, but he's only worth considering in deeper tight end-premium leagues at this juncture.
items.title: Ian Thomas scores touchdown in Week 11

items.author: Joshua Kellem
items.desc: Michael Mayer caught one of four targets for four yards before exiting the Raiders' 38-24 loss to the Broncos in Week 11 with an injury.
items.impact: Mayer had an opportunity to fill in for Brock Bowers, who was inactive Sunday with ankle and quadriceps injuries. The former, however, also exited the game, leaving Ian Thomas to pick up some of the slack. Thomas caught a 19-yard touchdown. Mayer's injury designation and availability for Week 12 against Cleveland will need to be monitored.
items.title: Michael Mayer exits Week 11 with injury

items.author: Joshua Kellem
items.desc: Jalen Nailor caught one of five targets for 16 yards in the Raiders' 38-24 loss to the Broncos in Week 11.
items.impact: Nailor had two would-be touchdowns negated by penalties Sunday. The former came via offensive pass interference, while Fernando Mendoza crossed the line of scrimmage before throwing the latter. So, the box score doesn't tell the entire story here. That said, Nailor remains difficult to start with Jack Bech and Tre Tucker combining for 19 targets.
items.title: Jalen Nailor held to one reception in Week 11
